name: Ramino Pokerato
description: Ramino Pokerato is an Italian Rummy game that combines draw-and-discard melding with poker-style betting. Players receive 10 cards from a double deck with four Jokers; after an optional blind and betting round, play proceeds with draw from stock or discard, then discard, until a player goes out by melding 10 cards in sets and runs and discarding the 11th.
deck: Double deck of 52 cards plus four Jokers (108 cards).

history.origins: Ramino Pokerato is an Italian Rummy variant that combines Rummy melding with poker-style betting. The name means 'Pokerised Rummy' and applies to several Italian games; the version with Jokers and betting is described by John McLeod from Antonio de Sebastiano and others.
timeline: 20th century: Italian Rummy variant with poker-style betting documented; played in Italy and Cyprus.
history.cultural: Played in Italy and Cyprus (Pokerize variant); often played for stakes with agreed fixed blind and raises.
history.evolution: Multiple local variants exist with different stake rules and special-hand bonuses; contract version (Carioca) uses eight deals with different opening melds.

setup.players: Three to five players (best); adaptable to more with extra packs.
setup.deck: Double deck of standard 52-card packs plus four Jokers (108 cards total).
setup.dealing: Dealer shuffles and is cut by player to dealer's right. Each player receives 10 cards dealt one at a time. Remainder is stacked face down as stock.
setup.equipment: Table and chips or agreed stakes.

rules.objective: Win the hand by being first to go out with 10 cards in valid sets and runs and one discard, and collect the pool; or win the betting round when all others fold.
rules.gameplay: After the deal, the first player to dealer's left may post a blind (fare il buio). Others then call, fold, or raise in poker fashion. If two or more remain, play starts: each turn a player draws one card from the stock or the top of the discard pile, then discards one card face up. A player may go out after drawing by laying 10 cards in sets (three or more of same rank) and runs (three or more consecutive same suit; Ace may be high or low). No melds are shown until going out. Jokers are wild. The winner takes the pool.
keyRules: Sets are three or more cards of the same rank; runs are three or more consecutive cards of the same suit; Ace may be next to King or Two.
First player may post a blind before looking; others call, fold, or raise. If only one remains after betting, that player wins the pool without play.
Each turn: draw one from stock or top discard, then discard one. Going out: expose 10 cards in valid combinations and discard the 11th.
Special hands (e.g. one 10-card run without Jokers) may entitle the winner to extra payments from active players.

strategy.basic: Prioritise forming sets and runs; use Jokers to complete high-value combinations; consider folding weak hands when the blind is raised.
strategy.intermediate: Track discards to infer opponents' melds; balance going out early versus waiting for a special-hand bonus; manage bet size against hand strength.
strategy.advanced: Optimise blind and raise timing; exploit position in betting; balance immediate go-out versus drawing for a stronger closing hand.
tips: Going out is not mandatory when possible; you may continue to try for bonus hands.
When drawing from stock, the top discard is still available to others in some variants.

variations.name: Ramino Pokerato con Jolly immaginario
variations.description: Played with double deck and no printed Jokers; when going out, one card in hand may be nominated as a wild card to complete one combination.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variant differs by wild-card rule only; engine overrides can be added when implementing optional Joker rule.

variations.name: Ramino Pokerato carioca
variations.description: Contract version: eight deals, each with a different opening meld requirement; 13 cards each; no poker-style betting; scoring by card values; winner of game takes game pool.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Contract and scoring differ significantly; overrides for deal count, hand size and meld requirements to be added from source.

variations.name: Ramino Pokerato con rilancio
variations.description: Betting version with blind and raises (rilancio); same draw-discard and go-out rules as main game.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Same as main game with standard betting; no engine overrides needed for base implementation.

scoring.description: Winner of each hand collects the pool. Special hands may entitle the winner to extra payments from active players.
scoring.winCondition: First player to go out with 10 cards in valid sets and runs (and discard the 11th) wins the hand and collects the pool; or the last player remaining after all others fold wins without play.

synthesis.shortDescription: Italian Rummy with poker-style betting: draw, discard, and go out with 10 cards in sets and runs.
